title: ATL Mint Geek Bar Pulse X 25000
description:
ATL Mint Geek Bar Pulse X 25000
Experience Pure Flavor
Discover a new standard in vaping with the ATL Mint Geek Bar Pulse X 25000, the ultimate disposable vape designed for unmatched convenience and exceptional flavor.
Refreshing Mint Bliss in Every Puff
Dive into a cool, crisp mint sensation with every inhale. The ATL Mint flavor delivers a perfect balance of refreshing coolness and smooth satisfaction, giving you a taste experience worth savoring.
Sleek, Convenient, and Disposable
Crafted for maximum ease of use, the Geek Bar Pulse X 25000 is a hassle-free disposable vape that’s ready to go whenever you are. No need to worry about refills, charging, or maintenance. Just grab, vape, and enjoy wherever life takes you.
Key Features
Puff Count
:
Up to 25,000 (Regular Mode) or 15,000 (Pulse Mode)
E-liquid
:
18mL, 5% nicotine
Battery
:
820mAh rechargeable (USB-C)
Display
:
Smart 3D Curved LED Screen
Coils
:
Dual Mesh for superior flavor
Modes
:
Soft, Normal, Pulse
Airflow
:
Adjustable for customized draw
Designed with You in Mind
Lightweight and ergonomically designed, this vape fits perfectly in your hand or pocket, making it an ideal choice for on-the-go vaping. With a robust capacity, the Geek Bar Pulse X 25000 ensures you enjoy long-lasting performance before needing a replacement.
Elevate your vaping experience today with the ATL Mint Geek Bar Pulse X 25000. Smooth, flavorful, and oh-so-simple.
